tickets.title: Coordinate manual transfer path for restricted shares
tickets.text: Coordinate a manual transfer path for Daria Nettlewhisk’s restricted Paper Otter Systems shares, as Velvet Acorn Custody cannot move them through the regular electronic transfer feed.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to coordinate that manual transfer path by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Address IRA registration name variance
tickets.text: Address the name variance on Daria Nettlewhisk’s traditional IRA transfer paperwork, where the source shows Daria Mae Nettlewhisk and the receiving profile shows Daria M. Nettlewhisk, which is blocking the transfer.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the IRA registration name variance by 2025-01-07.

tickets.title: Obtain latest Jonas rollover IRA statement
tickets.text: Obtain the most recent statement for Jonas Nettlewhisk’s rollover IRA from Velvet Acorn Custody, as the receiving custodian requires a current statement before accepting transfer instructions.
tickets.evidence: Follow-up is needed to obtain the most recent Jonas rollover IRA statement by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Set up inherited IRA receiving account
tickets.text: Set up a separately titled receiving account for Daria Nettlewhisk’s inherited IRA from Iris Juniperjingle, as the standard IRA registration used for Daria’s own retirement assets is not suitable.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to set up the inherited IRA receiving account by 2025-01-09.

tickets.title: Place residual cash and income sweep instruction
tickets.text: Place a residual cash and income sweep instruction with the Velvet Acorn Custody transfer desk to ensure dividends and interest posted after the initial asset list are transferred.

tickets.title: Review cost-basis import for taxable lots

tickets.title: Provide tax coordination report for transferable positions

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to provide that tax coordination for taxable positions during the transfer by 2025-01-13.

tickets.title: Relocate recurring household income transfer
tickets.text: Relocate the monthly household cash transfer from the old Velvet Acorn Custody money market source to the new Thimble Harbor Custody cash sleeve after the new account is funded.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to relocate the recurring household income transfer by 2025-01-15.

tickets.title: Establish cash reserve at receiving custodian
tickets.text: Establish a cash reserve sleeve at Thimble Harbor Custody before trading, to cover property-tax, tuition, and caregiving expenses without relying on market sales during the transfer period.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to establish the cash reserve at the receiving custodian by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Update Household Profile and Planning Assumptions
tickets.text: Refresh the household profile for Daria Nettlewhisk. Confirm current household members, contact preferences, employment status, retirement target assumptions, tax filing status, dependent or caregiving changes, key professional contacts, and any new planning priorities. Record evidence sources in the CRM and flag items that affect retirement income planning, IRA rollover guidance, or tax-conscious investment management. Update the trusted contact listing to reflect whether Selma Nettlewhisk or another relative should be designated at the receiving custodian.

subTasks.title: Confirm Household and Contact Details
subTasks.text: Verify household members, preferred names, addresses, phone numbers, email preferences, trusted contact status, and communication permissions for {client_or_household_name}. Note any missing confirmations or outdated fields.

subTasks.title: Refresh Employment, Income, and Retirement Assumptions
subTasks.text: Update employer status, expected retirement timing, recurring income sources, benefits changes, and IRA or 401(k) rollover considerations. Capture the evidence reviewed, such as client confirmation, pay information, benefit summaries, or account statements.

subTasks.title: Review Tax, Estate, and Professional Contact Fields
subTasks.text: Confirm tax filing status, CPA or attorney contact placeholders, estate document status, beneficiary review needs, and any household life event changes. Leave placeholders blank when the client has not provided the information.

subTasks.title: Document Changes and Route Follow-Ups
subTasks.text: Summarize completed updates, unresolved questions, and planning impacts. Create follow-up tasks for missing documents, advice updates, and client outreach where needed.

tickets.evidence: Follow-up is needed on the trusted contact and household profile change by 2025-01-20.

tickets.title: Complete paper certificate replacement affidavit process
tickets.text: Complete the paper certificate replacement affidavit process for the two legacy Silver Marmot Energy certificates associated with the taxable account, as they cannot be transferred electronically until the affidavit is filed.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete the paper certificate replacement affidavit process by 2025-01-14.
